sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:00)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Radios, 2 x Cameras, Keys, 2 x Keytags, 1 x Ops Phone, 3 x Vests.
Welfare sweep on Nike, Cotton On, Localito complete, no issues. Heading up to Victoria St; 77 Convenience requesting we move along a vagrant loitering outside ingesting illegal substances.

Arrived at the store; the vagrant had already been moved along by the council. Continued welfare check on the store. Spoke to staff who, at their request, asked that we trespass the vagrant from the store.
Approaching and issuing the vagrant a verbal trespass notice.
Vagrant was compliant, did not cause any issues; we agreed to let him obtain his belongings and move along. Vagrant has now moved along, no further issues.
No further issues to report on Victoria St; Federal St sweep clear, no issues. Heading over to the Cathedral.
Welfare check on the Cathedral, clear, no issues. Heading towards Commercial Bay.
Arriving at Commercial Bay; no issues to report on Hobson St.
Full sweep around Commercial Bay, no issues. Welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, clear. Heading to Gore / Fort St.

Welfare sweep on Gore St, no issues. Walkthrough Fort St: a vagrant who was being aggressive in public assaulted the Prestige guard working at Walker and Hall as we were making our way over to welfare check. We gave chase as the vagrant was assaulting members of the public while running; he was chased into the carpark on Chancery.
Standing by the carpark and commencing a sweep in case of finding the vagrant.
Off Tyler St, found a lady who had passed out and vomited; standing by for authorities to arrive.
Authorities arrived; standing down and resuming patrol. Heading back to HQ for a quick toilet break.
Toilet break complete; commencing welfare sweep going up Queen St.
Welfare sweep of all local stores along upper Queen St complete, no issues to report.
Lorne St welfare check clear, no issues to report.
Auckland Library sweep complete, no issues. Continuing to Aotea.
Arriving at Aotea Sq; commencing full sweep.
Welfare sweep complete. Heading to Elliott St for welfare checks.
Elliott St walkthrough clear. Standing by Elliott Stables to catch up on reports.
Reports up to date. Full welfare check on Elliott Stables, Darby, clear, no issues to report.
Heading back to HQ for 20:00 guard stand down.
First guard standing down; standing by for response calls while charging the ops phone.
Second guard standing down, no further issues to report.
Equipment handover: 2 x Keytags, 1 x Ops Phone, Charger, Keys, 2 x Radios, 2 x Body Cams.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
In office charging ops work phone due to low percentage.
Taking Take 10 guard down to destination.
Arrived at check-in location; standing by till guard starts.
Received a call from management to take place at Aces until guard handover.
Arrived at Aces; all clear, no issues. Guard has arrived; heading back to Headquarters for night shift guards.
Commencing welfare checks on Bar 101 and Elliott Street, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Commencing welfare checks on Britomart McDonald's and additional stores.
Welfare check with Take 10, all clear, no issues to report.

Response call from Chancery Square — physical altercation involving a group of adults, 2 males and 3 females. By the time we arrived, one party had already left; we spoke to the other party who were intoxicated, told them to leave the premises and informed them they were trespassed from Chancery Square. (Video on body cam.) No police needed. No issues to report.
Standing by in office charging ops phone due to low percentage (16%).
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Standing by showing presence. Commencing patrols down Queen Street making our presence known.
Checks down Fort Lane, all clear, no issues to report.

Physical commotion in front of Kong nightclub between 2 groups of male individuals; quickly intervened to stop the situation escalating. Standing by showing presence until one group left the premises.
The group of individuals have left the area.
Assisting an unresponsive male having seizures in front of Kong nightclub; standing by until the ambulance arrives on site.
Ambulance has arrived; guiding them to destination.
Ambulance has left with the unresponsive male; all clear, no issues.
Caught a group of teens harassing an old man at Britomart next to McDonald's; quickly intervened and stopped any problematic matter. Standing by for the safety of the old man.
Assistance provided to the member of the public; all clear, no issues. The teenagers have left the scene. Continuing patrols.
Bar 101 all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Check on Darby St, Elliott Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal St towards Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham St towards Queen St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store and Customs Mart, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St and the bottom of High St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High St Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep all around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear.
Heading back to HQ for floor checks and our 30-minute break.
